454892.overview: Amiga Yoomp! is a fast-paced arcade game that brings the classic gameplay of its Commodore 64 and Atari counterparts to the 16-bit Amiga platform. Players control a bouncing ball as it navigates 3D-textured tubes filled with different types of tiles, each with unique properties. The goal is to collect points while avoiding traps and hazards that threaten to end the run. Yoomp! is designed to run smoothly on a wide range of Amiga systems, including the A500, A600, A1200, CDTV, and CD32, delivering retro gaming fun with.
